degradation_evidence.before: WebP codec accepted any tile/strip dimensions without validation, potentially causing integer overflow
degradation_evidence.impact: Harness needs to generate inputs with various dimension combinations to maintain coverage

gap_introduced.description: New constraint on WebP tile/strip dimensions (max 16383x16383)
gap_introduced.harness_needs_update: Yes - needs to generate test cases with boundary dimensions (16383, 16384) and extreme values

rationale: This is an input format constraint that changes what constitutes valid input. Fuzzers unaware of the 16383 limit will waste mutations on rejected inputs.
